blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Rondae Hollis-Jefferson is setting his sights on another deep playoff run after making his long-awaited return for TNT during Tuesday’s 142-87 rout of guest team Macau in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup. Hollis-Jefferson had 22 points, six rebounds, five assists and two steals during his 22-minute appearance at Ninoy Aquino Stadium, using the comeback to prepare himself for the big games ahead. “I mean, that’s always the goal for an organization of this caliber,” Hollis-Jefferson said, referring to the mission of adding to the three championships he had already won since his PBA debut back in 2023. “I think for […]...
